competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.subtitle: Sync coverage (what the system keeps fresh) and Match Bar flags (what visitors see) — fully independent.

empty.title: No competitions yet
empty.description: Add a competition using its provider ID to get started.

picker.empty: No competitions yet. Add one from the Competitions page first.

form.providerIdHint: The competition's numeric ID at the provider (e.g. 365Scores).
form.name: Name

confirm.deleteText: This will delete “{{name}}” and its synced fixtures. This cannot be undone.

competitions.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage competitions.

matchBarSettings.title: Match Bar
matchBarSettings.desc: Enable or disable the homepage Match Bar. Which fixtures appear is controlled from the Competitions page (competitions flagged “In Match Bar”).
matchBarSettings.enableDesc: Show the bar to visitors at the top of the site.
matchBarSettings.emptyWarning: Heads up: the bar is enabled but no competitions currently qualify — it won't appear to visitors until at least one competition is flagged accordingly on the Competitions page.
matchBarSettings.noPermission: You don't have permission to edit settings.

competitions.title: Match Bar Competitions
competitions.desc: Manually choose which competitions appear in the bar. A selected competition stays enabled even with zero current fixtures, and appears automatically once fixtures arrive.

sportsHomeBarSettings.title: Sports Home Bar
sportsHomeBarSettings.desc: Enable or disable the competitions bar at the top of the Sports homepage. Fully independent from the Match Bar — its own selected competitions.
sportsHomeBarSettings.enableDesc: Show the bar to visitors at the top of the Sports homepage.
sportsHomeBarSettings.emptyWarning: Heads up: the bar is enabled but no competitions currently qualify — it won't appear to visitors until at least one is flagged accordingly.
sportsHomeBarSettings.noPermission: You don't have permission to edit settings.

competitions.title: Sports Home Bar Competitions
competitions.desc: Manually choose which competitions appear in this bar — fully independent from the Match Bar selection, even for the same competition.

sportMenu.title: Sport Menu
sportMenu.subtitle: Sport section menu items — editorial category links or functional sections (matches/results/competitions...), freely ordered as a one-level-deep tree.

empty.title: No items yet
empty.description: Add an item to start building the Sport section menu.

form.title: Title
form.sectionKeyHint: A system-recognized value — doesn't necessarily mean a real page exists for it yet.

confirm.deleteText: This will delete “{{title}}”. This cannot be undone.

sportMenu.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage the Sport menu.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.desc: Colors and default theme for the Sport section — independent from the rest of the site.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.desc: Default sport, country, and competition when first entering the section.

sportSettings.noPermission: You don't have permission to edit settings.
